mods.name: ProtoProx
mods.description: Proxy Protocol (V1 & V2) support for Minecraft servers

releases.notes:
**Compatible with Fabric (Minecraft 1.20.1+) and NeoForge (Minecraft 1.21.1+)**

**(Tested on Fabric 1.20.1, 1.21.1, 1.21.11, 26.3 and NeoForge 1.21.1, 1.21.11, 26.3)**

**Features:**
* Proxy Protocol v1 and v2 support, for both IPv4 and IPv6 players
* The player's real IP is applied before Minecraft activates the connection, so vanilla, Fabric, NeoForge and mods never see the proxy's IP
* The real IP shows up everywhere: logs, IP bans, whitelists, connection throttling, and mods that read the address from Minecraft or Netty
* One jar for both Fabric and NeoForge, across many Minecraft versions
* Server side only, with nothing to configure
* Connections with an invalid PROXY protocol header are rejected and logged

Please ensure you read the project README before using this mod!
